narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten odd numbers make ten squared, so the sum is one hundred.
<bookmark mark='about'/>Each house number is about one hundred, and there are ten of them.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ten squared adds the first ten odd numbers from one, not these.
